moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Hype
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday with Arsenal facing Coventry. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Big Games This Weekend
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive opening weekend in the Premier League! Hull City take on Man Utd Saturday, and Sunday sees Newcastle vs Liverpool. What's your top pick?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Weekend
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festivals take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, featuring co-headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye, with Kasabian headlining Thursday.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just over a week until Reading & Leeds Festivals! Who are you most buzzing to see – Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine or the mighty Kasabian?

angles.name: Leeds Festival Local Angle
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is nearly here! Bramham Park gets ready for Chase & Status, Fontaines D.C. and more this August Bank Holiday. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's premier dance music festival, Creamfields, returns to Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-30, with headliners including Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Disclosure, Tiësto, and Armin van Buuren.

angles.name: Creamfields Excitement
angles.copy: Creamfields is just over a week away! Get ready for four days of the biggest names in dance music with Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia and Disclosure. Who's heading to Daresbury?

angles.name: Dance Anthem Playlist
angles.copy: Prepping your playlist for Creamfields? We're blasting tracks from Tiësto, Armin van Buuren, and Amelie Lens. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz, soul, hip hop, and club culture, runs from August 20-23 in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, and is now sold out.

angles.name: We Out Here Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off this Thursday in Dorset! Get ready for four days of incredible jazz, soul, hip hop and electronic vibes curated by Gilles Peterson. Who's got tickets to this sold-out event?

moments.title: The Weeknd's London Run Concludes
moments.blurb: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' continues its run at Wembley Stadium in London, concluding tomorrow, August 19th.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend Recap
angles.copy: Still buzzing from The Weeknd at Wembley? The After Hours Til Dawn Tour wraps up its London dates tomorrow. What was your favourite moment?

moments.title: Ariana Grande at The O2
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' hits London's O2 Arena tomorrow, August 19th, with further dates on August 20th and 27th.

angles.name: Ariana O2 Excitement
angles.copy: It's almost time! Ariana Grande brings her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' to The O2 tomorrow. Who's got their outfit ready for the pop spectacle?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart (dated August 13-19) sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In', and a new entry from Madonna & Kylie Minogue with 'Love Sensation' at Number 8.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Big congratulations to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean, holding strong at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'! Deserved?

angles.name: Pop Royalty Team-Up
angles.copy: Pop royalty alert! Madonna and Kylie Minogue have teamed up for 'Love Sensation', new in the chart at Number 8. Are you loving this iconic collaboration?

moments.title: Happy 48th to Jeff Stinco
moments.blurb: Jeff Stinco, the guitarist for Canadian pop-punk band Simple Plan, turns 48 on August 22nd.

angles.name: Simple Plan Guitarist
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Simple Plan's awesome guitarist, Jeff Stinco, who turns 48 this Thursday! What's your favourite Simple Plan track?

moments.title: Happy 64th to Shaun Ryder
moments.blurb: Shaun Ryder, the iconic frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the one and only Shaun Ryder! From Happy Mondays to Black Grape, what's your favourite tune from the Madchester legend?

moments.title: Happy 48th to Julian Casablancas
moments.blurb: Julian Casablancas, the distinctive lead singer of The Strokes and The Voidz, turns 48 on August 23rd.

angles.name: Strokes Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 48th Birthday to Julian Casablancas, the legendary frontman of The Strokes! What's your go-to Strokes anthem?

moments.title: Happy 30th to Chrissy Costanza
moments.blurb: Chrissy Costanza, the lead vocalist of Against The Current, celebrates her 30th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: ATC Frontwoman
angles.copy: Big Happy 30th Birthday to Chrissy Costanza, the incredible voice of Against The Current! What's your favourite ATC track?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is just around the corner! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer? Festivals, staycations or a BBQ?

angles.name: End of Summer Vibes
angles.copy: It's almost the August Bank Holiday, signalling the unofficial end of summer for many. What's one thing you absolutely HAVE to do before autumn arrives?
